value.answer: Tomorrow in Denver looks cooler, about 65°F, roughly 15 degrees below today. Partly sunny early, then a 30% chance of rain after 3 p.m. that picks up into the evening. Tuesday night drops to the low 40s and 30s, with a breeze from the north-northeast at 6 to 10 mph.
